full_judgment:
KM Hasan J: The petitioner seeks leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 22-5-2000 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3869 of 1995 discharging the Rule. 

 4. The accused-petitioner then moved a bail petition before the learned Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 694 of 1995 in which he was granted bail. The case was ultimately transferred to the Court of Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, for disposal and was fixed on 22-8-1995 for framing charge. On that day the accused petitioner filed an application under section 241 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, praying for discharging him from the case. But the learned Metropolitan Magistrate framed charge against the accused- petitioner under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code by his order dated 22-8-1995. 

 5. In the meantime the complainant-respondent filed a Money Suit No. 22 of 1995 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka for realisation of money. Being aggrieved with the proceeding in CR Case No. 1211 of 1995 before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, the petitioner moved a Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3869 of 1995 under section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the High Court Division and a Rule was obtained which was ultimately discharged by the judgment and order dated 22-5-2000. 

 6. The learned advocate appearing for the accused-petitioner submits that the High Court Division erred in law in failing to consider that the allegations made in the petition of complaint is regarding civil liability. The Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 3869 of 1995 should, therefore have been made absolute. 

 7. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate and gone through the judgment. The High Court Division found that the complaint petition discloses an offence of inducement by the accused to part with money. By such inducement the complainant paid money to the accused on the undertaking by the latter to repay the same as and when complainant demanded it. But the accused misappropriated the money by issuing cheques which were dishonoured. This establishes prima facie case of deception. Moreover, there is no bar as to initiation of a criminal case if a civil suit is pending on the selfsame fact.
